proposals.note: Every default the design does not fix is a coordinator proposal to be calibrated by walk-forward results on real history.
from_design_r4_r11: half-life 10 sessions (short) and 60 sessions (medium), stated as 'about'
minimum training history 10 years of TAIEX
not_fixed_by_design: volatility medium horizon fits non-overlapping 5-session returns (short fits daily returns)
min_input_sessions=500: floor to fit anything; below it the axis is unavailable
trend states: 3 (up, mean_reverting, down), with the middle state by descending cumulative return mapped to mean_reverting; risk appetite states: 2 (on, off)
jump_penalty_grid=(10,30,100) chosen on a trailing validation window as the smallest penalty within the switch gate; grid_size=0.05; n_init=5
gates: max_switches_per_year=6.0, min_expected_duration_sessions=5.0 (smallest mean run length of the delayed signal), min_label_stability=0.8, min_refits=3, stability_window_sessions=60
ruptures audit: Pelt l2, penalty 10.0, tolerance 10 sessions; reported, not gating
macro rules: expansion if monitoring score >= 23 and leading index not falling, contraction if score <= 16, otherwise slowdown

feature definitions: EWM return, EWM downside deviation, Sortino-like ratio, EWM breadth ratio (advancers-decliners)/(advancers+decliners); risk appetite: trailing z-scores of institutional net flow, TX foreign net OI, put/call OI ratio, margin balance change, breadth
approver id regime-validation-gate and approval_decision_id regime-validation:<artifact id> on the approved transition

findings: services/research is first on sys.path in the deployed image (Dockerfile --app-dir services/research and PYTHONPATH), and it contains a package named statsmodels (the governed adapter). A plain `import statsmodels` there loads the adapter, not the library, so adding statsmodels to the lock alone would not have made it importable. regime.real_statsmodels() imports the library with that directory removed from the path; test_library_loads_when_the_research_directory_shadows_statsmodels reproduces the shadow in a subprocess. services/research/statsmodels/adapter/cointegration.py still does a plain `from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import coint` (not changed here; production_cointegration.py already removes the directory).
The jumpmodels sort_by='cumret' orders states by descending cumulative return (state 0 = best), verified in vendored base.py; labels are (up, mean_reverting, down) and (on, off).

Backfilled rows carry available_time = first acquisition, so read_feature_series shows a historical row only after its acquisition. The fit reads once at the decision time and uses strictly causal transforms; walk-forward does not re-read at historical decision times (that would hide every backfilled row).
Unrelated to this task: tests/e2e/test_persona_oss_runtime_matrix.py fails in an environment without QuantLib (it passes in the locked venv).

services/research/statsmodels/worker.py (not in this task's contract, not edited) still falls back to the sample dataset when STATSMODELS_DATASET_PATH is unset; it now ends in a StatsmodelsWorkflowError because it passes the stub when the real backend is off. A follow-up could drop the sample fallback.

data_required_for_a_real_fit.volatility: tw_index_daily TAIEX close for at least 2012-01-02..latest (about 3630 sessions already on the collector host; needs REGIME-DATA-INDEX-BREADTH-INTAKE deployed and the history pulled into hosted source-ingest). Medium horizon uses every fifth session of the same series.
data_required_for_a_real_fit.trend: tw_market_breadth_daily whole_market_advancers and whole_market_decliners, one row per session, at least 500 sessions (min_input_sessions) and ideally the same ten years as the TAIEX history for walk-forward approval. The collector holds them only from 2026-11-13, so the coordinator needs to run the MI_INDEX backfill (--start-date/--end-date) on the host for 2016-11-01..2026-11-12 (ten years; the minimum to fit a candidate is the most recent ~500 sessions, from about 2024-11).
data_required_for_a_real_fit.risk_appetite: tw_market_institutional_flows (foreign, trust, dealer net shares), tw_market_margin_balances margin_balance, taifex_market_positions tx_foreign_net_open_interest, taifex_market_put_call open_interest_ratio, each complete per session (the market chip loader withholds incomplete sessions), at least 500 sessions, plus the breadth above. Per-stock T86 holds two years from 2024-11-11 (about 490 sessions, just under the floor); depth of the margin, TAIFEX positions and put/call market series is not stated in the task context.
data_required_for_a_real_fit.macro: tw_macro_ndc monitoring_score and leading_index monthly. The loader converts normalized rows through observations_from_row, which needs a `field` and `value` on the row; if hosted NDC rows are stored in the provider-series shape the macro axis stays unavailable until a mapping is added (follow-up).
